name: Should I wet sand drywall or dry sand it?

mainEntity.name: Should I wet sand drywall or dry sand it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wet sanding can work for small touch-ups and can reduce airborne dust, but it is not always best for large areas or heavily textured repairs. Use a damp sponge lightly, avoid soaking the wall, and stop if the paper face starts to soften or pill.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wet sanding is good for small touch-ups and less dust, but dry sanding is usually better for larger areas. Keep the sponge damp, not soaked, and avoid damaging the drywall paper.
